LanguageData.TY_Armed_mining_machine.label: «Крот»-1
LanguageData.TY_Armed_mining_machine.description: "Mole"-1 Excavator is a mechanoid researched by the River Valley Federation in 5472 for excavation, mining, and underground construction. Its broad head houses a laser emitter that utilizes high-intensity beams for subterranean drilling.\nHowever, due to political turmoil in 5472, the "Mole" never achieved nationwide deployment. The establishment of the Sovereign Confederation also led to the loss of numerous advanced research achievements, causing the "Mole" and vast mechanoid technologies to fall into the hands of rim world mechanoids.
